reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Improved ArgoCD Integration: Kyverno-managed webhook configurations are auto-cleaned up upon uninstallation", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: This is a new beta cleanup mechanism that will only become the default in a future release, so nothing breaks for existing environments in 1.13.0.

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a beta, finalizer-based cleanup that makes sure Kyverno-managed webhook configurations are removed on uninstall. It is not yet the default cleanup strategy.
